Kiran P: Heads up - backup scanner flagged an external partner bucket containing Vault sealed blobs: s3://partner-sync/redwood/export-2026-03-22-sealed.tar.gz
sec-bot: ALERT: sealed-blob-external-upload detected for serviceAccount:partner-sync-sa (rule: sealed-blob-external)
Louise H: can you paste object metadata and the KMS key used for wrapping?
Kiran P: metadata: uploader=partner-sync-sa@partner-prod, acl=private, wrap-key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-hsm-v3. crc32: 4c3d2b
Greg J: containment plan: 1) snapshot KMS IAM + Vault audit 2) remove decrypt binding for partner-sync-sa 3) copy object to sec-quarantine 4) start Vault token accessor sweep. I'll do 2&3 now.
Kiran P: commands I'm running:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy wrap-hsm-v3 --location=global --keyring=partners > /tmp/policy-before.json
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-hsm-v3 --location=global --keyring=partners --member="serviceAccount:partner-sync-sa@partner-prod" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
aws s3 cp s3://partner-sync/redwood/export-2026-03-22-sealed.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/partner-export-2026-03-22-sealed.tar.gz
```
sec-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-162 (severity: medium) assigned to Kiran P, Greg J
Louise H: plan after containment: create new key version, run a canary rewrap for ~25 objects, validate restores, then full rewrap. Add CI gate to onboarding so partner onboarding cannot grant cryptoKeyDecrypter without manual review.
Partner-Infra: partner paused the job and will provide the export config. They confirm accidental staging export.
Greg J: token sweep in progress (revoked 3 accessors). Saved IAM snapshot to gs://ops/audit/policy-before-3733333333.json. Scheduling postmortem 2026-03-23 14:00. Moving follow-ups to INC-2026-162. Closing chat thread to reduce noise. :white_check_mark:
